rationale: The assistant went straight to the sensible first check ('Please unplug the machine first, then check if you can turn that impeller by hand'), correctly read the free-spinning impeller with a snapped fin and the 170-ohm coil as a mechanical pump failure, and recommended a drain pump sourced against the model he gave without inventing a part number. It hedged appropriately on whether the pump is separate from the filter housing ('on most Hoover washer-dryers of this type'). Weaknesses: it never raised Hoover's parts warranty before sending him to buy a pump, and it did not tell him to drain residual water and isolate power before removing the pump itself, only before the impeller check.
